The PNG files are recorded JMA nowcast tiles from the [jma-radar fixtures at 637fd83](https://github.com/ringsaturn/jma-radar/tree/637fd832c4183c34843bc45af577d1d6262e4067/tests/fixtures/hrpns). Original source: [JMA High-resolution Precipitation Nowcast](https://www.jma.go.jp/bosai/nowc/). The fixture PNGs are unmodified. See [JMA website terms](https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/info/coment.html).

The `.levels` file contains all 65,536 row-major unsigned byte levels generated by `jma_radar.decode.decode_tile` from the matching unmodified JMA PNG, using the same pinned reference commit.
